text: The Patriots head to Chicago on Thursday Night Football for a Week 7 matchup against the Bears at 8:15 PM ET, where Drake Maye will face off against fellow draft-class peer Caleb Williams in what amounts to a reunion between two quarterbacks who've known each other for years through shared football camps. The injury report is looking grim for New England, with the team ruling out five players ahead of kickoff: cornerbacks Carlton Davis III (neck), Karon Prunty (hamstring), and Channing Canada (hamstring), along with starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and Ben Brown (knee), while Romeo Doubs has been placed on injured reserve with a shoulder injury. Meanwhile, running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to do the little things that make him invaluable to the offense, sitting on the cusp of reaching 100 carries for the sixth straight season—a testament to his reliability in both carry and pass-catching duties. Experts are weighing in with their picks and prop bets for the primetime showdown, so if you're looking to catch the game or place some action, you've got plenty of analysis to work with before Thursday night's kickoff in the Windy City.
